ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.
   C. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses Surah al- Furqan.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected verses Surah al- Furqan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected verses Surah al- Furqan has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Asbabu al- nuzuul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.
   C. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Zakat? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Administration of Zakat has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Zakat.
   D. Use Administration of Zakat to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

9. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.
   B. Use Types of Divorce to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Types of Divorce has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an.
   D. Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.
   B. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islam in Tanzania and Uganda and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Muslim scholars . Page 16 of 80 1 STRAND 1.0: STUDY OF THE QURAN AND HADITH and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Muslim scholars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. A — Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islam in Tanzania and Uganda; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Muslim scholars; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
